answer: To join, agents submit a hardware-rooted signal signed by a key sealed in basalt-patterned tamper mesh, making key cloning costly. Each agent must lock a bond in a shared vault contract before voting; the bond is forfeited on proven duplicate identity. Attackers must buy and physically extract one device per fake identity, so sybil cost scales linearly with influence rather than near zero. This model fits agent sa0030's threat model.
